author: evaleval
description:
Every Eval Ever Datastore
	

A community database of AI evaluation results in one schema. Scores scraped from
leaderboards, read out of papers, and produced by local evaluation runs all land in the same
record format, so a number can be reused with its provenance attached instead of re-scraped.
This repository is the data itself: one JSON record per model per evaluation run, each
carrying one or more scored results, with optional per-sample companion files.
